requirements.quote: In order to be licensed in this state, nonresidents who are licensed in another state must meet any requirements established by the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license by false or fraudulent representation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: whenever a license, a school approval, or an instructor approval has been obtained by false or fraudulent representation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of a violation of this chapter or the commission's rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: whenever a licensee, an approved school, or an approved instructor has been found guilty of a violation of this chapter, of the rules and regulations promulgated by the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unfair trade practices as enumerated in the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or of any unfair trade practices, including, but not limited to, those listed in this Code section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to sell or rent, discriminating, or making discriminatory statements based on race, color, religion, sex, disability, familial status, or national origin
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Because of race, color, religion, sex, disability, familial status, or national origin: Refusing to sell or rent after the making of a bona fide offer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally advertising material which is misleading or inaccurate or misrepresents any property, terms, values, policies, or services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally advertising material which is misleading or inaccurate or which in any way misrepresents any property, terms, values, policies, or services of the business conducted

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to account for and remit any money coming into the licensee's possession which belongs to others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to account for and remit any money coming into the licensee's possession which belongs to others

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingling the money or other property of the licensee's principals with the licensee's own
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commingling the money or other property of the licensee's principals with the licensee's own

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain and deposit in a separate, federally insured account all money received as escrow agent or temporary custodian of funds of others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain and deposit in a separate, federally insured account at a financial institution all money received by such broker acting in such capacity, or as escrow agent or the temporary custodian of the funds of others, in a real estate transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose in writing to a principal fees, rebates, referral payments, or other things of value received in connection with the transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to disclose in writing to a principal in a real estate transaction any of the following: The receipt of a fee, rebate, or other thing of value

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing or attempting to represent a real estate broker other than the broker holding the licensee's license without express knowledge and consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing or attempting to represent a real estate broker, other than the broker holding the licensee's license, without the express knowledge and consent of the broker holding the licensee's license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting a commission or other valuable consideration from anyone other than the broker holding that licensee's license without consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting a commission or other valuable consideration by a licensee from anyone other than the broker holding that licensee's license without the consent of that broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the dual capacity of agent and undisclosed principal in any transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the dual capacity of agent and undisclosed principal in any transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guaranteeing or authorizing any person to guarantee future profits from the resale of real property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Guaranteeing or authorizing any person to guarantee future profits which may result from the resale of real property

disciplinary_grounds.description: Placing a sign on property offering it for sale or rent without written consent of owner and failing to remove after listing expiration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Placing a sign on any property offering it for sale or rent without the written consent of the owner or the owner's authorized agent and failing to remove such sign within ten days after the expiration of listing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering real estate for sale or lease without knowledge and consent of owner or on unauthorized terms
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering real estate for sale or lease without the knowledge and consent of the owner or the owner's authorized agent or on terms other than those authorized by the owner or the owner's authorized agent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inducing any party to a contract to break it for the purpose of substituting another contract with another principal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inducing any party to a contract of sale or lease, or a brokerage agreement to break such contract or brokerage agreement for the purpose of substituting in lieu thereof any other contract or brokerage agreement with another principal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negotiating directly with an owner or purchaser knowing they have a written exclusive listing or brokerage agreement with another broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negotiating a sale, exchange, or lease of real estate directly with an owner, a lessor, a purchaser, or a tenant if the licensee knows that such owner or lessor has a written outstanding listing contract in connection with such property granting an exclusive agency or an exclusive right to sell to another broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Indicating that an opinion given regarding a listing or purchase price is an appraisal without holding an appraiser classification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Indicating that an opinion given to a potential seller, purchaser, landlord, or tenant regarding a listing, lease, rental, or purchase price is an appraisal unless such licensee holds an appraiser classification in accordance with Chapter 39A of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing acts of a licensee on property in another state without being licensed in that state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing or attempting to perform any of the acts of a licensee on property located in another state without first having been properly licensed in that state or otherwise having complied fully with that state's laws regarding real estate brokerage

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a commission or compensation to any person for performing real estate licensee services who has not first secured the appropriate license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying a commission or compensation to any person for performing the services of a real estate licensee who has not first secured the appropriate license under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to include a fixed date of expiration in any written listing agreement and failing to leave a copy with the principal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to include a fixed date of expiration in any written listing agreement and failing to leave a copy of said agreement with the principal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to deliver within a reasonable time a completed copy of any purchase agreement or offer to buyer and seller
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to deliver, within a reasonable time, a completed copy of any purchase agreement or offer to buy or sell real estate to the purchaser and to the seller

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to timely ensure that client or customer receives a copy of the closing statement if provided to the licensee at closing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to timely ensure that his or her client or customer receives a copy of the closing statement from a real estate transaction if the closing statement is provided to the licensee at closing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any substantial misrepresentations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any substantial misrepresentations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the express written consent of all parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the express written consent of all parties to the transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of an associate broker, salesperson, or community association manager to place deposit money or other trust funds in the custody of the broker as soon after receipt as practicably possible
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of an associate broker, salesperson, or community association manager to place, as soon after receipt as is practicably possible, in the custody of the broker holding the licensee's license any deposit money or other money or funds entrusted to the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Filing a listing contract or document purporting to create a lien based on a listing contract to cast a cloud upon title when no valid claim exists
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Filing a listing contract or any document or instrument purporting to create a lien based on a listing contract for the purpose of casting a cloud upon the title to real estate when no valid claim under said listing contract exists

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated incompetency to act as a real estate licensee or other conduct constituting dishonest dealing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having demonstrated incompetency to act as a real estate licensee in such manner as to safeguard the interest of the public or any other conduct whether of the same or a different character than heretofore specified which constitutes dishonest dealing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a brokerage agreement knowing another broker has an exclusive brokerage agreement with that owner, purchaser, or tenant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a brokerage agreement, a sales contract, or a lease from any owner, purchaser, or tenant while knowing or having reason to believe that another broker has an exclusive brokerage agreement with such owner, purchaser, or tenant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep for three years true and correct copies of all sales contracts, closing statements, trust accounting records, and other transaction documents, or failing to produce them on request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep for a period of three years a true and correct copy of all sales contracts, closing statements if provided to the licensee, any offer or other document that resulted in the depositing of trust funds, accounting records related to the maintenance of any trust account required by this chapter, and other documents relating to real estate closings or transactions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being a party to any falsification of any portion of any contract or other document in any real estate transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being or becoming a party to any falsification of any portion of any contract or other document involved in any real estate transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to obtain written agreement of parties regarding interest earned on trust funds in interest-bearing accounts before depositing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to obtain the written agreement of the parties indicating to whom the broker shall pay any interest earned on trust funds deposited into an interest-bearing account prior to depositing those funds into such account

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose in a timely manner to all parties in a real estate transaction any agency relationship the licensee may have
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to disclose in a timely manner to all parties in a real estate transaction any agency relationship that the licensee may have with any of the parties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of forgery, embezzlement, obtaining money under false pretenses, theft, extortion, conspiracy to defraud, felony, sexual offense, probation violation, or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Where an applicant for any license or approval authorized by this chapter has been convicted of forgery, embezzlement, obtaining money under false pretenses, theft, extortion, conspiracy to defraud, or other like offense or offenses or has been convicted of a felony, a sexual offense, a probation violation, or a crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false statement of material fact on application or submitting falsified application to the commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Where an applicant or licensee has made a false statement of material fact on his or her application or caused to be submitted or been a party to preparing or submitting any falsified application to the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of a violation of the federal fair housing law or state fair housing law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Where an applicant or licensee has been found guilty of a violation of the federal fair housing law or Article 4 of Chapter 3 of Title 8 by an administrative law judge or a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with or obey a final order of the commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure of a licensee to comply with or to obey a final order of the commission may be cause for suspension or revocation of the individual's license after opportunity for a hearing.

bonding_required.quote: The commission may require that each broker who provides community association management services under this chapter and who collects, controls, has access to, or disburses community association funds shall at all times provide or be covered by a fidelity bond or fidelity insurance coverage

insurance_required.quote: The commission may require that each broker who provides community association management services under this chapter and who collects, controls, has access to, or disburses community association funds shall at all times provide or be covered by a fidelity bond or fidelity insurance coverage

definition_quote.value: "Broker" means any person who, for another, and who, for a fee, commission, or any other valuable consideration or with the intent or expectation of receiving the same from another: (A) Negotiates or attempts to negotiate, or assists in procuring prospects for the listing, sale, purchase, exchange, renting, lease, or option for any real estate or of the improvements thereon; (B) Holds himself or herself out as a referral agent for the purpose of securing prospects for the listing, sale, purchase, exchange, renting, lease, or option for any real estate; (C) Collects rents, assessments, or other trust funds or attempts to collect rents, assessments, or other trust funds; ... (H) Performs property management services or community association management services; ...
